DML.SELECT: SELECT node_parent_id as "nodeParentId", node_child_id as "nodeChildId", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM conf.plan_node_hierarchies WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO conf.plan_node_hierarchies (node_parent_id, node_child_id, enabled, visible) VALUES (:nodeParentId, :nodeChildId, :enabled, :visible)
DML.DELETE: DELETE FROM conf.plan_node_hierarchies WHERE node_parent_id = :nodeParentId AND node_child_id = :nodeChildId
